title: Étale derived global sections with closed support
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $X$ a scheme, and $W\subseteq X$ an open subscheme [def-weil-open-immersion]. On the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], for a sheaf $M$ of $R$-modules put $\Gamma_{X\setminus W}(X,M)=\ker(\Gamma(X,M)\to\Gamma(W,M|_W))$. This defines an additive left exact functor to $R$-modules, with its kernel inclusion into global sections. Define $R\Gamma_{X\setminus W}(X,-)$ on the bounded below derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] to be its right derived functor, computed on bounded below injective resolutions. Its cohomology modules are cohomology with support.
